metadata.title: A Machine-Checkable Operational Standard for Systemic Tau τₛ and the Discrete Extramental Clock (RECD)
metadata.description:
We present systemic-tau-formal v0.1.10 as documented in this English preprint (document version 0.1.10-r1): an open monorepository that states the operational core of the Systemic Tau (τₛ) paradigm and the Discrete Extramental Clock (RECD) in a form accepted by a formal verifier.

New in this document/software pin: termwise superstable logistic roots (period 1 and 2 unique; period-4 cascade-window existence; secondary residual zero ~3.96); hybrid cascade with geometric tail and δ-limit; free-c operational uniqueness retained. Formal Rolle mono discharge, true termwise SS for all n, and C²-open map-space renorm remain research-scale open.

The Lean 4 + Mathlib package encodes regime bands, the gate function g(τₛ), partition and monotonicity lemmas, and a laboratory construction package linked to period-doubling cascade ideas and Feigenbaum’s constant δ. Accompanied by a Python reference core, golden rational bridges, continuous integration, and a citable Zenodo software deposit.

Source: github.com/johelpadilla/systemic-tau-formal · path papers/preprint-standard-formal/.

Software pin: systemic-tau-formal v0.1.10 — concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21516059 (version DOI assigned at software deposit).

metadata.notes: Preprint document 0.1.10-r1 aligned to software v0.1.10. Does not claim classical Feigenbaum universality, termwise SS for all n, or free-c without pin. Files: frozen PDF + LaTeX source + VERSION/CHANGELOG.
